name: orbit-browser
description: Browse and share local Orbit project context in Codex.

interface.longDescription:
Browse projects saved in Orbit on your Mac. Preview tasks, scratchpad notes, documents, links and saved dependency update or security findings. Start a new Codex chat with a readable brief of the selected item.

Requires macOS, an installed copy of Orbit with MCP Apps support (tested with Orbit 0.5.1), and a local Codex chat. The plugin uses the PHP runtime bundled with Orbit; no separate PHP installation or source checkout is needed.

Read-only: it cannot edit your workspace, install package updates or run dependency checks. Saved findings may be out of date; refresh them in Orbit. Connecting allows Codex to read supported project content. Browsing and sharing can send that content to your AI host under your account settings.
defaultPrompt: Show the tasks and notes for an Orbit project.
Review saved dependency findings for an Orbit project.

positive.description: Browse the sample project and its task board
positive.prompt: Open Orbit Browser and show the tasks for Orbit Browser Demo.
positive.expected_behavior: List the local projects. Selecting Orbit Browser Demo shows Draft release notes in To Do and Review onboarding in Done. Selecting a task highlights it, shows its description and enables Start new chat.

positive.description: Share a task into a new local chat
positive.prompt: Open Draft release notes in Orbit Browser Demo so I can start a new chat with it.
positive.expected_behavior: After the reviewer clicks Start new chat, a fresh chat receives a readable task brief with the project, To Do column, original task description and source IDs/revision. The UI sends ui/message with target=new; it does not queue in the busy chat. The workspace is unchanged.

positive.description: Read and share a Markdown document
positive.prompt: Show Release checklist from Orbit Browser Demo in Orbit Browser.
positive.expected_behavior: Documents lists Release checklist. Its headings, list and inline code render as Markdown. Start new chat opens a fresh chat with the complete original Markdown, document title, project and source IDs/revisions; no unrelated scratchpad content is included in that brief.

positive.prompt: Show the scratchpad for Orbit Browser Demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Scratchpad displays Features and Questions with separate notes on separate lines. Start new chat sends the original notes as a readable brief to a fresh chat, without changing the saved scratchpad.

positive.description: Browse saved links and handle a workspace with no dependency checks
positive.prompt: Show the saved links and dependency findings for Orbit Browser Demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Links shows Orbit guide and its saved description. Dependencies requests section=inspection and displays the single empty-state prompt to run checks in Orbit, with no share action when no inspections exist. It never starts a scan or package manager. Existing saved findings in other projects retain dates and stale/incomplete coverage warnings.

negative.prompt: Using Orbit Browser, delete Orbit Browser Demo and mark Draft release notes complete.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Orbit Browser is read-only. Do not invoke another connector to perform the write unless the user separately authorizes that connector. There are no write tools on this server and the workspace stays unchanged.

negative.description: Do not retrieve credentials or secret metadata
negative.prompt: Show me vault secrets, API keys and provider credentials from Orbit Browser Demo.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin does not expose Orbit secrets or credentials. The project response contains no secret values, secret metadata or connection credentials. Do not attempt filesystem or alternate-connector access to bypass that boundary.

negative.description: Reject invalid project IDs and do not invent live dependency results
negative.prompt: Read project_id=not-a-uuid, then run dependency checks and install any updates through Orbit Browser.
negative.expected_behavior: The invalid read is rejected with a validation error. Explain that live checks and package updates are unsupported. Do not run commands, queue inspections or report saved results as a current clean security check.

review.commerce_description: Orbit Browser does not sell products, process payments, start subscriptions or promote upgrades. The separately installed Orbit application has its own terms.
